newsitem.title: UK: London silver fixes firmer, may look to gold.
newsitem.headline: London silver fixes firmer, may look to gold.

text.p: SILVER - Fixed at 434.50 cents vs 427.75 cents previously. Came off 50-percent retracement. Upside potential unclear. May rely on gold for direction.
GOLD - Steady and firmer so far at $320.75/$321.25. Short covering and some physcial interest.
PLATINUM - Barely changed so far at $396.00/$400.00.
PALLADIUM - Unchanged at $166/$170. Russian material moving.
